sections.description:
REACHRIGHT Support Chat gives your church's website admins step-by-step help right inside the WordPress dashboard.

  • Instant answers to common website questions, from editing pages to events, forms, billing, Google Ad Grant and Local SEO.
  • Video walkthroughs that play right in the chat.
  • Quick support requests to the REACHRIGHT team, pre-filled with your site details, with screenshots and urgent handling.
  • Available in the dashboard, on your live site (top bar) and in the Cornerstone builder. Visible to administrators only.

Managed by REACHRIGHT Studios. Questions? Email support@reachrightstudios.com.
sections.changelog:
1.18.0

  • Simpler topic buttons: Page error, Editing, Events, Billing and More.
  • REACHRIGHT icon, banner and details in WordPress.

1.17.0

  • Quick topic buttons above the message box: Page error, Editing, Photos, Events, Forms, Login, Email, Billing, Ad Grant, Local SEO.

1.16.0

  • Billing, Google Ad Grant and Local SEO answers updated with the support team's FAQ; 5 new answers.
  • Grant account questions go to your project manager.

1.15.0

  • New answers for billing, Google Ad Grant and Local SEO (based on reachrightstudios.com).
  • New topics: Google Ad Grant, and Local SEO & Google listing.

1.14.0

  • Starting suggestions: 3 random picks from the top support issues, plus "Page error or not loading". A fresh mix for each new conversation.

1.13.0

  • Fixed: suggestions disappeared after moving to another dashboard page.

1.12.0

  • Chat title in capitals: REACHRIGHT SUPPORT.

1.11.0

  • The "My website is down" suggestion is now "Page error or not loading".

1.10.0

  • "Need help?" button in the Cornerstone builder's top bar, next to Save. The chat opens on the left so Cornerstone's panels stay clear.

1.9.0

  • New "Need help?" item in the WordPress top bar opens the chat, including while viewing the live site (logged-in admins only).
  • In the page editors, the chat can be opened from the top bar without covering the editor.

1.8.0

  • The chat asks for more details when a question is vague ("help", "website issue") or could mean several things ("photos", "event"), with tappable options.
  • Browse answers by topic.

1.7.0

  • New "My website is down" suggestion opens an urgent support request straight away.
  • Attach up to 3 screenshots to a request (choose files or paste).

1.6.0

  • Admins wait 5 minutes between support requests, to prevent duplicates.

1.5.0

  • REACHRIGHT logo shown as the chat's avatar.
  • The admin's name appears above their messages.
  • Fixed bold text in one answer.

1.4.0

  • Chat renamed to REACHRIGHT Support.
  • New "Contact our team" link at the bottom of the chat opens the request form anytime.

1.3.0

  • Chat only: no settings page, uploads or database options in WordPress. Everything is managed by REACHRIGHT Studios.
  • Answers come from REACHRIGHT's database, with a built-in backup copy.

1.2.0

  • The chat now appears only in the WordPress dashboard, for logged-in staff.
  • Choose who sees it: administrators only, or editors too.
  • Ticket form is pre-filled with the admin's name, email and site; tickets include site details (WordPress, PHP, theme).
  • Greets admins by name; hidden while editing pages.

1.1.0

  • Updates install from GitHub.
  • Answers can load from Firebase.
  • Loom video walkthroughs.
